messages.author: 9dda904b2c7a149c
messages.subject: Re: bgAdjustRma error
parts:
Dear Karen,

The error is telling you what it is telling you: that writing of
version 3 (v3) CEL files is not supported. (FYI, this is an error
thrown by affxparser, not aroma.affymetrix.) There are two options:

(1) use the affy package to analyse your data (with only 10 mouse 430
chips this should be well within your computer's resource constraints)
(2) convert your v3 CELs to v4 CELs.

If you want to try option (2), this might do the trick:

- copy your CEL files to a temporary directory
- start R and setwd() to your temporary directory

library(affxparser)
files <- list.files(patt="[Cc][Ee][Ll]$")
dir.create("converted")
outPath <- "converted"
outFiles <- paste(outPath, files, sep="/")
for (kk in seq(files)) {
convertCel(files[kk], outFiles[kk], verbose=TRUE)
}

- move the files from <temp directory>/converted to your rawData/
Gladstone.EB.ES/... directory

You will also have a backup of the original CEL files in the temporary
directory.

Cheers,

Ken

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: bgAdjustRma error
parts:
Hi,

for most steps aroma.affymetrix expect binary CEL files, although it
can read CEL files of any versions. I've updated the code such that
it will an error saying that the input CEL file is of an outdated
version whenever it needs a binary version. Binary CEL files have
version 4, and old ASCII CEL files have version 3. As suggested by
Ken, you can use affxparser to convert ASCII CEL files to binary ones.
Working with ASCII CEL is painfully slow.

/Henrik
